CREATE TABLE SalesOrderFact(
    [SalesOrderID] VARCHAR(300),
    [OrderDate] VARCHAR(500),
    [CustomerID] VARCHAR(400),
    [SubTotal] VARCHAR(700),
    [TaxAmt] VARCHAR(300),
    [Freight] VARCHAR(500),
    [TotalDue] VARCHAR(600),
    [OrderQty] VARCHAR(300),
    [ProductID] VARCHAR(500),
    [UnitPrice] VARCHAR(600),
    [UnitPriceDiscount] VARCHAR(600),
    [LineTotal] VARCHAR(500)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN
)


SELECT * FROM SalesOrderFact


SELECT [ProductID],COUNT([SalesOrderID]) AS 'Count of Sales Orders' FROM SalesOrderFact
GROUP BY [ProductID]
ORDER BY [ProductID];
